acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest-host Tobin Low talks to comedian Tig Notaro about a jarring ride to school with her son.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Aviva DeKornfeld heads to the Calgary Stampede to watch as men try out a machine designed to simulate menstrual cramps.
acts.title: There Will Be Blood

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A man can’t seem to see anyone in his life for who they really are, plunging his life into chaos.
acts.title: Face Your Demons

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Senior Editor David Kestenbaum hears about a way to save some money and help save the world. All he needs is a little help.
acts.title: Pump It Up

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Marie Phillips reads a short story involving an aloof friend, a goose, and some extreme gardening.
acts.credits: Written and performed by Marie Phillips; Produced by Bim Adewunmi
